{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace
if [ -d /working ]; then find /working -printf '%p\t%y\n' 2>/dev/null > temp_workspace/raw_listing.txt; else : > temp_workspace/raw_listing.txt; fi
awk -F'\t' '$2=="f" {print $1}' temp_workspace/raw_listing.txt > temp_workspace/files_list.txt
awk '{ n=split($0,a,"/"); if(a[n]=="workspace") print $0 }' temp_workspace/files_list.txt > temp_workspace/candidate_paths.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do [ -f "$p" ] && printf '%s\n' "$p"; done < temp_workspace/candidate_paths.txt > temp_workspace/verified_candidates.txt
awk '!seen[$0]++' temp_workspace/verified_candidates.txt > temp_workspace/unique_verified.txt
wc -l < temp_workspace/unique_verified.txt > temp_workspace/match_count.txt
count=$(cat temp_workspace/match_count.txt)
printf '%s\n%s\n' "unique_verified: temp_workspace/unique_verified.txt" "match_count: $count" > temp_workspace/final_ready.txt
if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then echo yes; else echo no; fi"}
